name: SCL: 943 Warehouse Shipment Advice (AM → X12 → DCG)

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key) VALUES ('{{ $json.dedupeKey }}')
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO transactions (correlation_id, doc_type, direction, partner, stream, status, external_ids, payload_ref)
  SELECT '{{ $json.correlationId }}', '{{ $json.docType }}', '{{ $json.direction }}', 'DCG', 'TEST', '{{ $json.status }}', '{{ $json.externalIds }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.fileName }}'
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.correlationId }}' AS correlation_id,
  (SELECT id FROM ins) IS NOT NULL AS is_new,
  (SELECT id FROM logged) AS transaction_id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ConnectorId: 'c-71cf9ddb758b4376b', SendFilePaths: ['/scl-dcg-sftp-bridge/outbound/pending/' + $('Reattach File + Metadata').item.json.fileName], RemoteDirectoryPath: '/From_SCL_TEST' }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE transactions
SET status = 'sent'
WHERE correlation_id = '{{ $('Reattach File + Metadata').item.json.correlationId }}'
RETURNING id, correlation_id, status;

meta.instructions: Pulls up to 3 real AM purchase orders (falls back to one realistic sample if AM's test company has none yet), ports adapters/edi/x12-dcg/lib/{envelope,itemCode,build943}.js into the 'Build 943 X12' Code node (runs ONCE PER purchase order -- each PO is its own 943 shipment-advice transaction to DCG, matching 940's per-shipment pattern, unlike 888 which batches). No Inventory combine needed (unlike 940/888) -- DCG's 943 spec deliberately sends no UPC. Dedupes/logs to Supabase per purchase order, uploads each X12 file to S3, pushes it to DCG via StartFileTransfer -- StartFileTransfer's SendFilePaths already uses the correct $('Reattach File + Metadata').item.json.fileName reference from day one (the $json.fileName bug that silently broke 888/940's first sends). Known gaps (see adapters/edi/x12-dcg/schema-notes.md): options.warehouseCode is a placeholder ('001'), no canonical AM-to-DCG warehouse-code mapping exists yet; N9|CO position (header vs. trailing) is genuinely inconsistent between DCG's own two real samples; several W04 trailing elements seen in DCG's real sample are undocumented and deliberately not replicated. Also TBD: ISA sender/receiver IDs, and confirming transaction-type code 'PO' with Chi Cao (well-supported default from a real sample, not yet explicitly confirmed). After import, re-select credentials: Query Auth account (Get AM Purchase Orders), Postgres account (Claim & Log, Mark Sent), AWS account (Upload to S3, StartFileTransfer). Uses usageIndicator 'T' (test) and stream 'TEST' throughout.
